summary: This This Old House segment demonstrates upgrading a traditional manual boiler thermostat to a GPS-enabled smart thermostat that uses geolocation to adjust heating automatically as occupants come and go. The video frames the evolution of thermostats—from simple dial units to clock-programmable models to internet-connected devices—then provides a hands-on replacement: safely removing an old mercury thermostat, wiring the new unit’s R and W terminals, mounting the base plate, and configuring the accompanying app to communicate with the heating system and use location data for automatic temperature control. The content emphasizes energy-savings benefits of setback when away and covers practical installation steps, including safety and compatibility considerations for a typical gas-fired boiler with radiators.
